Key projects: Portland Building (Graves), AT&T Building (Johnson), Vanna Venturi House (Venturi). Remember: it's a philosophical stance, not just colorful decoration.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <Note>Postmodernism is fundamentally philosophical—about meaning, reference, and the rejection of universal principles. Not all colorful or historically referential buildings are Postmodern. Postmodernism is self-conscious and ironic; unironic historicism is mere revivalism. Also: Aldo Rossi's Neo-rational Postmodernism is austere and contextual, without garish ornament—proving Postmodernism is not defined by a visual style.</Note>

blocks.raw: <Warn>Critical: Don't confuse Postmodernism's ironic historical quotation with earnest 19th-century eclecticism. Postmodernism quotes history self-consciously and often parodically. Also: the movement critiques modernism's universalism and ethical foundations, not just its aesthetics. Postmodernism asserts that no universal design principles exist and that context, memory, and meaning matter profoundly.</Warn>
